title: The Reappearing Graveyard
content: Many of my dreams are places I know from my past but slightly warped or mixed together. But the graveyard can appear in a memory location or a new random location. It’s not huge, maybe 20-60 graves, not overgrown, and sometimes has stone paths. The graves are older, Victorian looking, and sometimes are iron, or there are iron fences. There isn’t anything visibly wrong with the place, but every time I see it, I’m filled with dread, as if I shouldn’t go near or look to long or something terrible will happen. The first time I saw it was in a dream about the large hill and woods behind my grandmas house; there was a spot in the trees you could see through to the graves. Another dream, it was next to the road on a bright sunny day. In another, it was night and it was in my RL neighbor’s yard. Sometimes it’s just off the road, sometimes it’s far down the road and I can’t see it but I know it’s there. Sometimes in the middle of another location you wouldn’t expect. I don’t think it’s ever been inside or under water though. I never want to go in, but there’s no eerie sound, or warning signs, or anything ‘out of sorts’ but it’s terrifying somehow.
